answer: Equivocation-proof bonds stop bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits, files one juniper log under one onyx stamp: one key, one log. Two conflicting logs from one key, or one juniper log for two identities, let anyone submit both; the mesa auditor burns both bonds. Filing costs 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Rented-key rings fail: two signatures prove it. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its bond.
